headline: House rule to set debate terms for a 2024 spending bill and a bill freezing certain Iranian funds; it was voted down.
what_it_does: This resolution would have set the House rules for debating and voting on two bills. One was H.R. 5893, which would fund the Departments of Commerce and Justice, science agencies, and related agencies for the 2024 budget year. The other was H.R. 5961, which would freeze certain Iranian funds tied to the 2023 hostage deal between the United States and Iran. The resolution itself would only have set the debate process, not passed either bill. The House rejected it on November 15, 2023.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: It would have set the time limits and amendment rules for debating the two bills.
